INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

3. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
